content.name: Goggles of Night
entries: While wearing these dark lenses, you have {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense darkvision}, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.

content.name: Goggles of Night
entries: While wearing these dark lenses, you have {@sense Darkvision|SRD52} out to 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|SRD52}, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.
